description: Don't destructure Vue props or copy their values at the top level of setup() or script setup; the copies lose reactivity.

violation.message: Keep `props` whole and read its fields where used, or destructure with toRefs, so the values stay reactive.
Read this from `props` inside a computed, watcher or function in setup(), or use toRefs, so it stays reactive.
